plain.li: Well, that's the day spoiled.
I'll be thinking about that one tonight.
Nothing for it but to start again.

warm.li: Never mind me, I'll be right by supper.
It happens to all of us, I know, but it still smarts.
I'm all right, really, it was just a knock.

cheerful.li: Ah well, I've had worse weeks than this!
Could have been worse, could have been raining too.
Bad day, good story later.

gloomy.li: Of course it did.
I knew today would go like this.
One more thing, then.

cold.li: That will cost us, and I'll say how much later.
A mistake, and not one I'll make twice.
Unfortunate, and avoidable.

plain.li: Don't forget, it's {NAME} tomorrow.
I've had {NAME} on my mind all week.
It's {NAME} tomorrow, so get your chores done tonight.

warm.li: It'll be good to have everyone together tomorrow, for {NAME}.
I've put something by for {NAME} tomorrow.
Make sure the newer ones know what {NAME} is, before tomorrow.

blunt.li: Big day tomorrow, early night tonight.

cheerful.li: One more sleep till {NAME}, and I've laid out my good shirt.
Not long now till {NAME}, I've been counting.
I'm baking for tomorrow, so stay out of the kitchen!

gloomy.li: I always sleep badly the night before {NAME}.
Tomorrow's {NAME}, and I don't feel much like it.
Fewer of us for {NAME} this year than last.

cold.li: The hauling gets done today, because tomorrow's {NAME}.
Tomorrow's {NAME}; the work won't wait for it.
I've moved my own work to the evening, for {NAME} tomorrow.

plain.li: I'd only just got used to having it.
Not a word about why, either.
So "{WISH}" was only for a while, was it.

warm.li: I suppose someone needed it more, I hope so.
I'll ask what happened, gently.
I'm grateful I had it at all, I suppose.

blunt.li: I want to know who decided that.

cheerful.li: Easy come, easy go, I suppose.
Never mind, I'll ask for it again, nicely.
At least I got to enjoy it for a bit!

gloomy.li: Taken back, like I half expected.
Nothing good stays long here.
Back to how it was, then.

cold.li: Taken back without a word of explanation, and noted.
A promise broken is a debt, and I collect debts.
So the council's word lasts about a season.

plain.li: I still think about {ENEMY} more than I'd like.
Every stranger on the road looks like trouble to me now.
If that {ENEMY} turns up, come and get me first.

warm.li: Thank you all for watching my back, with {ENEMY} still about.
I sleep better knowing you're all here.
Don't worry about me, I'm all right, really.

blunt.li: I'm not done with {ENEMY}, not by a long way.

cheerful.li: I won't be caught napping twice!
I've been training, so {ENEMY} had better watch out.
One day I'll laugh about all this, just not today.

gloomy.li: Somewhere out there is {ENEMY}, and here's me, waiting.
I still flinch at sudden noises.
There are days I can't stop going over it.

cold.li: I know how that {ENEMY} moves now, and that's an advantage.
Next time, I'll be the one choosing the ground.
I've been patient, and patience runs out.

warm.li: I've been thinking things over, and I feel better for it.
I know where I'm headed now, and it's somewhere good.

blunt.li: I've got something to finish, so don't hold me up.

cheerful.li: I've got a feeling this is going to be my year.
Big things coming for me, you'll see!

gloomy.li: Some things you carry a long time.
I'm not where I hoped I'd be by now.

cold.li: I know what I want, and I'm working toward it.
One step at a time, and no step wasted.

plain.li: Everything would be easier with "{WISH}".
I keep thinking how "{WISH}" would change my days.
Has anyone said anything about "{WISH}"?

warm.li: No hurry, but I do still think about "{WISH}".
If "{WISH}" ever happens, I'll thank everyone twice.
I'd help with "{WISH}" myself, if someone showed me how.

cheerful.li: Just imagine "{WISH}", wouldn't that be grand?
I've already decided what I'll do first once "{WISH}" happens.
I've decided "{WISH}" is coming soon.

gloomy.li: If we last the winter, maybe "{WISH}" will happen.
I've stopped expecting "{WISH}", mostly.
Other people's wishes come first, it seems.

cold.li: I've noticed how overdue "{WISH}" is.
I asked for "{WISH}" through the proper channels.
Done properly, "{WISH}" would pay for itself in a season.

plain.li: I've got a dream to tell, if anyone's awake enough to listen.
[dream:Strange] In my dream the bell rang by itself and we all came running with spoons.
[dream:Sweet] A warm kitchen, in my dream, and nowhere I had to be.

warm.li: I dreamt about all of you last night, it was a good one.
Sit down, I want to tell you a dream while I still remember it.
That dream had me smiling before I was even up.

blunt.li: Had a dream, it was stupid, pass the bread.
Bad sleep, strange dream, that's all.

cheerful.li: I had the best dream, and you're all in it!
Wait till you hear what I dreamt about the cook.
My dream last night had a talking goat in it, and it was rude.

gloomy.li: I didn't sleep well, the dreams were bad.
I dreamt about the ones we lost again.
Don't ask me what I dreamt, I'd rather not say.

cold.li: An odd dream, I'll think about what it meant later.
So much detail in last night's dream, I must be overtired.
I remember every part of that dream, which is unusual for me.

plain.li: Everyone in, it's getting worse.
Secure the doors and stay away from the windows.
[thunder] That was right over us.

warm.li: Stay close, all of you, it'll pass.
Come in and sit with us till it blows over.
Has everyone got in, is anyone still out there?

blunt.li: Not weather to be out in.

cheerful.li: Listen to it howl!
Let's tell stories till it stops.
I'll make us something hot while we wait it out.

gloomy.li: The roof won't hold if it gets any worse.
Something always breaks in a storm like this.
I hate this sound.

cold.li: Check the roof and the stores once it's passed.
No one goes out until it's over.
We'll count the damage afterward, not before.

plain.li: First snow, and right on time.
Bring the washing in, it's snowing.

warm.li: Wrap up warm, the snow's here.
It's pretty, isn't it, the first snow.

cheerful.li: First snow, I'm going to make a snowman after supper.
Look at it, everything's gone white!

gloomy.li: Snow already, and so much still to do.
The cold months start now.

cold.li: Snow, so anything left in the fields is lost now.
Count the firewood again tonight, now the snow's here.

plain.li: Keep your head covered out there.
Even the stones are hot to touch.
[work:Growing] The fields need water twice a day in this.

warm.li: Here, have my water, I've had plenty.
Take a rest in the shade, I'll cover for you.
Wet your hair, it helps, trust me.

blunt.li: Too hot to work, too hot to talk.

cheerful.li: Who's for a bucket of cold water over the head after this?
I've never sweated so much in my life!
Hot enough to cook supper on the roof.

gloomy.li: It's never going to cool down.
The crops won't last another week of this.
I can't think straight in this heat.

cold.li: Water rations go up while this lasts.
Anyone who faints out there is a hand we lose for the day.
Heat like this kills the careless.

plain.li: The water bucket's frozen solid.
Don't stand still too long out here.
[work:Growing] Cover what you can in the fields tonight.

warm.li: Come in and warm your hands a minute.
Here, take my spare scarf.
Check on the old ones tonight, would you?

blunt.li: My fingers have quit on me.
Shut the door, you're letting the cold in.

cheerful.li: Cold enough to skate on the puddles!
My eyelashes have frost on them, look.
Hot soup tonight, I'm sure of it.

gloomy.li: Not everyone gets through cold like this.
The cold's in my bones now, it won't leave.
I can't remember being warm.

cold.li: Anyone working outside comes in to warm up every hour.
Count the firewood and halve the estimate.
Frostbite costs fingers, so keep your gloves on.

plain.li: You've done a lot with this place.
Quieter here than on the road, I'll give you that.
[happy] I'd come back, if you'd have me.
[unhappy] I've been in friendlier places, and colder ones.

warm.li: Your people have been very kind to me.
I'll remember the welcome, thank you.
It's good to sit somewhere safe for a night.

blunt.li: Roof's dry, food's hot, I'm happy.
I'll be off at first light.

cheerful.li: What a lovely spot you've got here!
I'll be telling everyone on the road about you.
Best supper I've had in weeks, thank the cook for me.

gloomy.li: Nice while it lasts, these places.
I've seen settlements like this go under.
I won't stay long, I never do.

cold.li: Good walls, I noticed them on the way in.
Your stores look well kept.
I'll mention you to the right people.

plain.li: There's dust on the road, and people under it.
Visitors, and they look like they mean to stay a while.

warm.li: Someone put some water on, they'll be thirsty.
They look tired, poor things.
Let's wave, so they know they're welcome.

cheerful.li: Visitors, I wonder what news they've got!
I wonder if any of them play cards.
I hope they've brought music.

gloomy.li: Strangers never bring good news.
I hope they don't bring sickness with them.
They'll want something, they always do.

cold.li: Count them, and count our stores.
Find out what they want before they set up.
Someone watch them till we know who they are.

plain.li: A wedding, and the council's own bell for it.
Here's to {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef}, long may it last.
Good to see so many out for {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef}.

warm.li: They're so happy, look at them.
I've been waiting for this day for them.
Be good to each other, you two.

blunt.li: Wedding's done, now where's the food?

cheerful.li: A wedding, I love a wedding!
Somebody fetch an instrument, this needs music.
I'm going to cry and I don't care.

gloomy.li: Lovely, I hope they get the years they deserve.
I had a wedding once, a long time ago.
Enjoy today, tomorrow's another matter.

cold.li: A good alliance, the colony is stronger for it.
Married before the council, it's binding now.
I've noted the date, for the annals.

plain.li: The others send their love, {OTHER_nameDef}.
I fixed the marker, it had tipped over.

warm.li: I brought you something, {OTHER_nameDef}, just a flower.
We're looking after each other, like you'd want.

cheerful.li: You'd have loved supper tonight, {OTHER_nameDef}.
The garden's doing well, you'd be pleased.

gloomy.li: It doesn't get easier, {OTHER_nameDef}.
I don't know what to say anymore, so I just sit.

cold.li: The colony is holding, {OTHER_nameDef}, I thought you'd want to know.
I keep this grave tidy, it's the least that's owed.

plain.li: The road goes on past those hills, all the way home.
I used to know every path back there.

warm.li: I hope they're all well, back home.
This is home too, now, I know that.

cheerful.li: I'll send word home one day, they'll never believe it.
Two homes is better than none.

gloomy.li: They've probably forgotten me by now.
I'll never see that place again.

cold.li: I left for good reasons, I remind myself.
Nothing back there I need.

plain.li: Pass the water round, my throat's still raw.
Put another log on, I'm not ready to go in.

warm.li: Sit closer, there's room.
I'm glad you're all still here.

cheerful.li: We did it, we actually did it!
Let's tell it again, the bit where they ran.

gloomy.li: I keep hearing it, even now.
We were lucky, that's all it was.

cold.li: We lost ground on the west side, we'll fix that.
They'll learn from today, so must we.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} always took the last piece of bread.
I still have the knife {OTHER_nameDef} gave me.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} would be glad to see us doing well.
I hope wherever {OTHER_nameDef} is, someone's kind to them.

blunt.li: Gone, and I'm still annoyed about it.

cheerful.li: I bet {OTHER_nameDef} is telling stories about us somewhere.
{OTHER_nameDef} would love what we've done with the place.

gloomy.li: I never said goodbye to {OTHER_nameDef} properly.
The ones I like best always seem to leave.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} was useful, and I miss that.
We've filled {OTHER_nameDef}'s work, not {OTHER_nameDef}'s place.

plain.li: There's the one that rises over the gate in winter.
I always find the same three first.

warm.li: Sit with me, it's a lovely night for it.
I like to think someone back home is looking at these too.

cheerful.li: A shooting star, did you see it?
I've named that cluster after the cook.

gloomy.li: They make you feel very small.
Some of those are probably long gone.

cold.li: The pole star hasn't moved, so neither will I.
Good for finding north, if nothing else.

plain.li: There's a weed trying its luck, out you come.
A bit more sun for you, and you'll be fine.

warm.li: You're doing so well, all of you.
I'll be back tomorrow, don't worry.

cheerful.li: Who's a good sprout, you are!
Look at that new leaf, well done.

gloomy.li: One frost and you're all done for.
I'll try, but I don't promise anything.

cold.li: This row needs thinning.
Too close together, half of these won't make it.

plain.li: Someone's been at the dried fruit again.
Rice, roots, meat, and not much of the last.

warm.li: Enough for everyone, that's what matters.
We've done well this season, all of us.

cheerful.li: Full shelves, my favorite sight!
We could feed an army, a small one.

gloomy.li: It never lasts as long as you think.
Half of this will spoil before we eat it.

cold.li: I'll ration the meat from tomorrow.
Recount, then lock up.

plain.li: How's your day been, really?
I saved you a seat, if you want it.

warm.li: I always feel better after a chat with you.
Stay as long as you like.

cheerful.li: Company, at last, I was going mad on my own!
You'll never guess what happened at the workbench today.

gloomy.li: It's been a long day, I didn't want to end it alone.
You don't have to talk, just stay.

cold.li: Tell me what's said about the council, I'm curious.
Company keeps the mind sharp.

plain.li: This happened before any of you were born, mostly.
I'll tell the one about the flood, it's a short one.

warm.li: My grandmother told me this one, now it's yours.
Settle in, it's a long one, but it ends well.

cheerful.li: This one always gets a laugh, wait for it.
Stop me if you've heard it, actually, don't.

gloomy.li: It doesn't end well, but it's worth telling.
I'm the last one who remembers this.

cold.li: There's a lesson in this one, if you're listening.
I'll keep it short and keep it true.
